description: Planner-LLM decomposes the query into ≤ maxHops anchored sub-queries; later hops are anchored to the running entity set so the engine never spends compute on candidates already disqualified. Built for questions that combine evidence across turns / sessions, or that require reasoning over multiple entities ("tenants who complained in April AND upgraded after"). Set synthesize=true to get a grounded answer with citations alongside the per-hop trace. Returns finalEntityIds + supportingFactIds (HotpotQA-style evidence chain) so the caller can audit which facts drove the answer. Embedding model on this tenant: set per workspace.

asOf.description: Valid-time as-of: facts true at this ISO 8601 moment (a retraction dated before it hides the fact; a fact learned after it still shows — not a knowledge snapshot)

maxHops.description: Hard cap on planner hops (default 3, capped at 5 — beyond that latency dominates)

synthesisGuardrails.description: Override guardrails when synthesize=true: strict closes to null on partial; lenient returns the answer with the verifier verdict; off skips the verifier

synthesize.description: Run the synthesizer over the final entity set and return a grounded answer with citations

userId.description: Per-user memory scope: tenant-global plus this user's personal facts; omit for tenant-global only
